architectureModel.separationBoundary: image4s owns geometry and sampled-image artifacts in one independent repository; locus4s owns imaging-free locus artifacts in another; reframe4s consumes both without reverse dependencies.

image4s-nifti: shared NIfTI-1 parsing and encoding on JVM and Scala.js
selectable UInt8, Int16, Int32, Float32, and Float64 output

nonRedundancyRules: Dim, Frame, FrameId, Point, Vec, Grid, GridId, and Affine are defined only by image4s-geometry.
Sampled[F,D,A,Role,R] is the sole owned sampled-image representation.
Image, ContinuousImage, CategoricalImage, and MaskImage may be aliases or zero-copy views only, never parallel storage owners.
FrameId, GridId, and locus DomainId are distinct identities and are not interchangeable.
reframe4s-motion is the sole reusable motion algorithm authority; ScalaFIM motion code may adapt it but may not redeclare pose, estimator, sampler, or application algebras.

knownDefects.description: ScalaFIM Frame[A] does not bind A to a unique runtime token; the same phantom type can be instantiated with multiple domains or grids.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Every new frame value owns a stable runtime FrameId, and frame-bound public values validate it at dynamic boundaries.

knownDefects.description: Affine3DMorphism and generic coordinate-map construction accept finite invertible 4x4 matrices without enforcing the homogeneous bottom row.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Validated affine construction requires the bottom row [0,0,0,1] within a documented tolerance.

knownDefects.description: Current ResamplingPlan construction does not verify that morphism endpoints agree with the source and target frames.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Typed frame endpoints determine plan construction; any dynamic adapter also performs runtime FrameId validation.

knownDefects.description: Current motion estimation and application ignore the actual image affine and reduce geometry to dimensions plus diagonal spacing.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Motion estimation and application operate in physical coordinates through the authoritative image affine.

knownDefects.description: Current pose smoothing and regularization average Euler components directly, which is discontinuous at angle wrapping and is not invariant under rigid-transform composition.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Interpolation, smoothing, and regularization use relative SE(3) group increments with explicit exponential and logarithm maps.

knownDefects.description: Current estimation and application duplicate trilinear interpolation over raw arrays and spacing-only voxel maps.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Use complete Grid affines and the canonical production interpolation or resampling machinery with explicit reusable workspaces.

knownDefects.description: Current motion values expose unsafe constructors, require-based public invariants, and untyped frame direction.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Use smart constructors, typed errors, live frame endpoints, and unambiguous movingToFixed or fixedToMoving names.

knownDefects.description: Current application rotates about a synthesized image center while exported pose matrices, composition, inverse, and metrics describe rotation about the physical origin.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Represent one physical rigid map. Any conditioning pivot is internal and is conjugated into the returned moving-to-fixed transform.

knownDefects.description: Current singular solves and exhausted rejected steps are reported as convergence, and changing overlap can lower the objective by dropping difficult samples.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Use typed termination and convergence failures, conditioning-aware small-system solves, fixed support or an explicit overlap penalty, and visible accepted-step diagnostics.

knownDefects.description: Current pyramid levels select strided coordinates without constructing filtered coarse images, RobustMean computes an arithmetic mean, and the configured capture width is silently capped.
knownDefects.requiredCorrection: Use filtered images on endpoint-preserving GridTower levels, accurately named template policies, and validated controls whose documented ranges are honored.

destinations.requiredCorrection: Point values must retain or validate runtime owning-domain identity, not only an ordinal and phantom type.

destinations.reason: Data-bearing fields and genuinely domain-neutral aggregation depend on locus4s-core but do not belong in the identity and finite-domain kernel.
Parcellation and searchlight workflows are neuroimaging analysis concerns and are foundation non-goals.

destinations.source: modules/image Dim, Frame, Point, Vec, GridSpec, GridCompatibility, GridId, and Affine concepts
destinations.requiredCorrection: This artifact is the sole geometry and affine authority. FrameId, GridId, and locus DomainId remain distinct; a grid owns one validated index-to-frame affine, and multiple grids may share a frame.

destinations.source: modules/image Axis, AxisSet, NDArray, and generic sampled-storage concepts
destinations.requiredCorrection: Sampled is the sole storage owner and validates grid.shape ++ nonSpatialAxes.shape against the Ravel value. SomeSampled packages runtime-discovered D, F, and R members without another owner. Image, ContinuousImage, CategoricalImage, and MaskImage are aliases or zero-copy views only.

requiredCorrections: Return typed errors instead of throwing from public readers and writers.
Return Sampled through SomeSampled or a caller-supplied frame instead of NeuroVol and NeuroVec.
Translate NIfTI first-axis-fastest payload offsets to Ravel logical axis order.
Require explicit scalar or label entry points.
Keep immutable NIfTI metadata separate from the Sampled storage owner.
Resolve single and pair physical files through typed suffix semantics and report every output path.
Preserve valid NIfTI extension blocks exactly and reject malformed block boundaries.
Make output datatype, scaling, and lossy integer conversion explicit typed policy.
retainedInScalaFIM: compressed staging and random-access workflow policy

destinations.requiredCorrection: Do not port ScalaFIM's public mutable DMat storage. image4s-geometry owns the validated Affine abstraction and uses Gale as the matrix authority.

destinations.source: modules/image NeuroSpace, NeuroImage, NeuroVol, and NeuroVec
destinations.reason: These names combine neuroimaging conventions and IO compatibility. Adapters must wrap or view Sampled without introducing another storage owner or geometry authority.
They mix locus bridging with ROI and NeuroVol compatibility behavior.

destinations.requiredCorrection: SpatialMap[A,B] consumes A and returns B. Map capabilities and composition remain in reframe4s-core; concrete group transformations belong to reframe4s-lie.
Resampling source A on target B requires SpatialMap[B,A]. The production affine plan enforces that polarity after satisfying AC-006.

destinations.reason: The reference sampler supplies fixtures and behavioral comparison. It may allocate and prioritize clarity, but it must not become the production resampling kernel or bypass AC-006.

destinations.requiredCorrection: DenseMap now stores absolute target coordinates on a source Grid through canonical component Sampled storage. RegistrationResult exposes fixedToMoving and a distinct bidirectional result exposes movingToFixed; no DensePull, InversePair, forward, backward, or inverse result aliases were ported.

destinations.reason: TransformGraph is a frame-identity multigraph over typed maps. Surface mappings, locus bridges, sparse operators, plugin payloads, workflow routing policies, and untyped DomainId values remain outside the foundation.

destinations.source: modules/motion Units, RigidPose, MotionTrace, MotionEstimate, and MotionError
destinations.requiredCorrection: Replace the unframed Euler pose algebra with frame-directed rigid isomorphisms over the authoritative affine; validate construction through typed errors; retain useful units, non-empty alignment, estimates, and diagnostics without unsafe public constructors.

destinations.source: modules/motion MotionEstimator, MotionControl, MotionPlan, and MotionProfile
destinations.requiredCorrection: Accept canonical D3-plus-Time Sampled data and optional masks; use full physical Grid affines, filtered images on GridTower levels, explicit workspaces, deterministic sampling, fixed support or an explicit overlap penalty, conditioning-aware solves, supported controls only, and typed per-frame termination reports. Retain capture, template, stencil, residual, and optimizer behavior only when an executable gate proves it.

Remove spacing-only voxel maps and the private raw-array trilinear kernel. Compile pull plans from full frame geometry, share immutable plan state, require explicit workspaces, and preserve validity or boundary evidence.

Retain validated volume, slice, and packet timing. Replace Euler-column interpolation and smoothing with relative SE(3) exponential and logarithm operations, reference-pose preservation, and wrap-boundary laws.

Own relative-pose displacement, framewise displacement, fit, and packet-correction measurements in reframe4s-motion with typed units and explicit non-finite policy. Keep DVARS, fMRI censor thresholds, confound selection, and reporting policy in ScalaFIM.

destinations.source: modules/motion MotionCorrectionResult, JVM IO, MotionBids, MotionCli, MotionReportWriter, and benchmark CLI
destinations.destination: ScalaFIM adapters over reframe4s-motion and image4s-nifti
destinations.requiredCorrection: ScalaFIM may compose estimation, application, QC policy, BIDS discovery, reports, and commands, but delegates all reusable motion computation and basic NIfTI mechanics to foundation artifacts.

destinations.source: modules/registration legacy HalfFlowEngine and revised ForwardMidpoint lane
destinations.requiredCorrection: Half steps remain independently integrated endpoints. Export requires a certified ordinary bidirectional pair, scoped topology certificates, and a passing multi-pair anatomical capability ledger; no HalfFlow value becomes SmoothIso or enters the stable umbrella.
